posts.title: Speed up SSH connections by splitting known_hosts per host
posts.description: My parallel SSH runs across about 1400 Linux hosts had slowed to over two minutes. Splitting known_hosts into one file per host cut that to about 30 seconds and reduced the wasted CPU load on my desktop. Continue reading →
